title: Active Directory Password Policy Audit
summary: Read-only Active Directory script for password policy audit.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects password policy audit data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Active Directory health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: ActiveDirectory PowerShell module with domain read access.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Active Directory
# Report: Password Policy Audit

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy | Select-Object ComplexityEnabled,MinPasswordLength,MaxPasswordAge,LockoutThreshold

documentation.readme: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script for Password Policy Audit. Validate module connection and tenant scope before running.

monetization.upgrade_cta: Unlock the full OperatorOS automation catalog and technician reporting packs.
